text: The identity ‖u + v‖² + ‖u − v‖² = 2‖u‖² + 2‖v‖² is the ___ law, and a norm arises from an inner product exactly when it holds.
explanation: Expanding both sides via bilinearity proves the identity in any inner product space; conversely (Jordan–von Neumann) a norm satisfying it comes from an inner product recovered by the polarization identity. The sup-norm on ℝ² fails it, so it is not an inner product norm.
